findings.title: Specify bounded link-kind storage and final ancestry validation
findings.problem: The protocol prohibits materializing selected files under any source link, including later links, but retains only path SHA256 duplicate keys and selected-file records. It does not specify how link kind survives scanning or how all source parents are checked before acceptance. The fixed parser-memory inventory omits that state.
findings.impact: Implementation may miss a link seen before or after its selected descendant, or add unreviewed state/pass behavior to meet the rule. The current fixed-memory contract is not complete.
findings.minimalRevision: Freeze a bounded link-kind/ancestry strategy. The proposed one-bit-per-slot link bitset adds131072 bytes, for33816576 bytes of duplicate/occupancy/link storage. Define lookup/probe failure behavior and selected-parent validation after the complete scan but before acceptance. Clarify whether earlier selected output is provisional staging, since a future source link is not knowable before that write.

findings.title: Freeze reserved PAX override validation for the custom parser
findings.problem: The allowlist, UTF8/path limits and ban on global path/link/size are specified. Exact reserved-value acceptance remains incomplete: PAX size numeric grammar/range, type-compatible local size/linkpath use, empty-value/deletion behavior, allowed hdrcharset spelling(s), and application/precedence rules are not frozen.
findings.impact: A custom parser could accept inconsistent encodings or apply reserved overrides differently while satisfying the current prose. This is a protocol-specification gap, not a claim that an implementation or retained source has failed.
findings.minimalRevision: Define reserved PAX values before implementation: size as bounded unsigned byte-count syntax, allowed member kinds and nonregular payload policy, validation of effective paths/links after overrides, explicit empty-value rules and hdrcharset vocabulary. State global/local handling and fail-closed behavior for incompatible overrides.

checks.existingTableArithmetic: PASS:33685504 bytes is correct for32-byte keys plus occupancy only. With the proposed link bitset,33816576 bytes.
checks.numericalCaps: The300000 headers fit1048576 slots;4096-probe exhaustion must fail. Name/frame/PAX/decoded/selected/receipt/output caps are explicit acceptance ceilings; no actual archive feasibility is certified.
checks.tailAndCRC: Coherent: two zero end blocks, zero-only decoded tail, all decoded padding/tail counted against2GiB, then gzip EOF/CRC. No scan or execution performed.
checks.publicationAndInputSafety: Direction is coherent: no-follow input, same-descriptor before/after identity checks, provisional worker outputs and owner-only acceptance after exit0/confirmed cleanup. Link ancestry and reserved PAX rules need the revisions above.
checks.metadataScope: Two fixed release metadata URLs after source validation; advertised wheel hashes remain distinct from wheel bytes and ABI. No wheel download/install/adoption.
checks.evidenceReviewed: Only the new protocol and arithmetic. No old source/evidence inventory repeated.
